description: Accommodations for students managing mental health conditions such as anxiety, depression, PTSD, or bipolar disorder
specific_accommodations: Excused absences for mental health days (up to 5 per semester)
24-hour extension on assignments during acute episodes
Permission to leave class briefly if needed without explanation
Reduced course load without financial penalty
Ability to take breaks during long exams
documentation_required: Letter from mental health professional (psychiatrist, psychologist, or licensed therapist)
notes: Student should establish connection with campus counseling center. Confidentiality maintained per FERPA and HIPAA.
